--- title: >- [store.OpenAIStore]{.doc-object-name .doc-class .doc-label .doc-label-class} body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} A vector store backed by OpenAI's Vector Store API. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/posit-dev/raghilda/blob/docs-embedding-providers/src/raghilda/_openai_store.py#L119-L589){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.CLASS} ```python store.OpenAIStore(client, store_id, *, attributes_spec=None, attributes=None) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} OpenAIStore uses OpenAI's hosted vector storage service for document storage and retrieval. Documents are uploaded as files and automatically chunked and embedded by OpenAI. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} ::: {#9d256b99 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} from raghilda.store import OpenAIStore # Create a new store store = OpenAIStore.create(name="my-store") # Or connect to an existing store store = OpenAIStore.connect(store_id="vs_abc123") # Insert documents from raghilda.document import MarkdownDocument doc = MarkdownDocument(content="# Hello\nWorld", origin="example.md") store.upsert(doc) # Retrieve similar chunks chunks = store.retrieve("greeting", top_k=5) ``` ::: ## Methods {.doc-methods}
Name Description
connect() Connect to an existing OpenAI vector store.
create() Create a new OpenAI vector store.
retrieve() Retrieve the most similar chunks to the given text.
### [connect()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method} ::: {.doc-subject} Connect to an existing OpenAI vector store. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/posit-dev/raghilda/blob/docs-embedding-providers/src/raghilda/_openai_store.py#L207-L255){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python connect(store_id, base_url="https://api.openai.com/v1", api_key=None) ``` ::: #### Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [store_id]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The ID of the vector store to connect to (e.g., "vs_abc123"). [base_url]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [["https://api.openai.com/v1"]{.st}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Base URL for the OpenAI API. [api_key]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : OpenAI API key. If None, uses the OPENAI_API_KEY environment variable. ::: #### Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [OpenAIStore]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : A connected store instance. ::: ### [create()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method} ::: {.doc-subject} Create a new OpenAI vector store. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/posit-dev/raghilda/blob/docs-embedding-providers/src/raghilda/_openai_store.py#L148-L205){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python create( base_url="https://api.openai.com/v1", api_key=None, *, attributes=None, metadata=None, **kwargs ) ``` ::: #### Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [base_url]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [["https://api.openai.com/v1"]{.st}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Base URL for the OpenAI API. [api_key]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : OpenAI API key. If None, uses the OPENAI_API_KEY environment variable. [attributes]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [AttributesSchemaSpec | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Optional schema for user-defined attribute columns. Attribute names use identifier-style syntax. OpenAIStore filters only support declared attributes. [metadata]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Mapping[str, str] | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Additional metadata to attach to the OpenAI vector store resource. [**kwargs]{.doc-parameter-name} : Additional arguments passed to the vector store creation (e.g., name, expires_after). ::: #### Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [OpenAIStore]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : A newly created store instance. ::: ### [retrieve()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method} ::: {.doc-subject} Retrieve the most similar chunks to the given text. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/posit-dev/raghilda/blob/docs-embedding-providers/src/raghilda/_openai_store.py#L479-L536){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python retrieve(text, top_k, *, attributes_filter=None, **kwargs) ``` ::: #### Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [text]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The query text to search for. [top_k]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The maximum number of chunks to return. [attributes_filter]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [AttributeFilter | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Optional attribute filter as SQL-like string or dict AST. Supports declared attributes only. Built-in columns such as `origin` are not available in OpenAI filters. [**kwargs]{.doc-parameter-name} : Additional arguments passed to OpenAI's `vector_stores.search()`. ::: #### Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Sequence[RetrievedOpenAIMarkdownChunk]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The retrieved chunks with their relevance metrics. :::
